reasoning: 驗證目標：請求 Page Down 時，畫面上全部項目移除，並以來自下方清單位置的新項目全數取代。為什麼這樣切：與 142 為方向相反的一對，條款分列且取代來源相反，各自成片（§8.2.1）；同樣以雙向斷言驗證取代的完整性。

tcs.tc_title: Page Down replaces every displayed item with the next-lower page
tcs.test_item: When a Page Down function is requested, all items on the list shall be removed and the new list items from the next-lower list positions shall replace all previously displayed list items
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. A list is displayed whose entries are individually identifiable and which is longer than three screens
5. The list is positioned so that the bottom of the list is not reached during the test
6. The list items occupying the next-lower positions are known
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record every entry shown
2. Request the Page Down function once
3. Read every entry shown
tcs.expected_result:
1. The entries are recorded
2. The request is accepted
3. None of the entries recorded in step 1 is shown, and every position holds an item from the next-lower list positions
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: Analog-chapter twin: CFTS024-4872501 (covered in the AM/FM deliverable)
